guidance_mae.description: Mean absolute error between a candidate guidance direction and the optimal joint-scaling guidance target.

win_rate.description: Fraction of evaluated grid/time-step cases where the candidate guidance direction is closer to the optimal target than the reference direction.

early_step_guidance_mae.description: Guidance-direction absolute error restricted to the lower-noise edge of each evaluation slice, catching methods that only work at high noise.

late_step_guidance_mae.description: Guidance-direction absolute error restricted to the higher-noise edge of each evaluation slice, catching methods that only work near the denoising endpoint.

early_step_win_rate.description: Win rate against the reference guidance direction on the lower-noise edge of each evaluation slice.

late_step_win_rate.description: Win rate against the reference guidance direction on the higher-noise edge of each evaluation slice.

relative_mae_reduction.description: Relative reduction in guidance MAE compared with vanilla classifier-free guidance on the same slice.

additional_vjp_per_guided_step.description: Machine-independent derivative-work overhead added per guided denoising step.

normalization: population std across ten genuine quality/reference variants only; no shortcuts
pooled_normalization: all successful output method rows including impossible claims; illustrative only
